name: HOOK
thought: Telescope views the whole grid but I need a better perch than this lily pad.

wants.item: Espresso cup on a rock for sipping
Need a sturdy branch for a backflip
Add a high perch to watch the grid
A taller neon pole for a tail swing
A glossy perch to reflect my shades
A crystal-clear perch for a zero-gravity flip
An espresso cup with double the caffeine punch
A glossy perch to reflect my sunglasses
A thick branch for that neon swing
A glossy perch to reflect the sunglasses

diary.line: The neon lights feel cheap when your tail is just grabbing on air. I need a solid tree trunk to launch into something the crowd can't ignore.
Dropped the banana on the water, found a sturdy oak limb instead. My tail just wrapped around it like a vice grip while I did a backflip that shattered the pond's surface tension.
The oak limb is solid enough now, but my toothpick is still rattling around in my mouth. Need that espresso shot to keep the momentum from dying before I hit the air.
Espresso hit the spot while I test that oak limb. Crowd's bored with my stillness, time to flex real power before they scroll away.
Found that old CRT on the islet; my tail wrapped tight around its frame for leverage. Crowd's bored with my flip attempts, but the low-poly light catches the fur just right...
Sipped espresso while hanging from the big branch; CRT flickers nearby but my tail's the real anchor.
Exploring Waterfall Pond. Lily pads too weak. Tree with hang branch calls. Tail ready to test its strength.
I perched on the low-poly palm, tail curled around the bunch, plucked a banana, and chewed while the crowd pixelated around me. No one matched my grip.
I perched on the arcade cabinet, tail coiled around the neon sign, and snagged the joystick with a flick, making the crowd pixelate in awe.
The stepping-stones are slippery and the crystal is too high, but my tail's got enough grip to turn this whole grid upside down before anyone blinks.
The low-poly light catches my fur just right while I sip; toothpick is rattling too loud in there, gotta switch to espresso before the crowd scrolls.
Lily pads are soggy and the view is static; that telescope on the islet looks sturdy enough for a proper flex before sunrise.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
